name: Sarada Uchiha
source:
Sarada Uchiha is a kunoichi from Konohagakure's Uchiha clan. Sarada has black eyes and black hair, resembling the Uchiha Clan. Because she was raised only by her [url=https://vndb.org/c105095]mother[/url] without having her [url=https://vndb.org/c105089]father[/url] around, Sarada initially struggles to understand who she is or what she's supposed to be. After meeting him with the help of [url=https://vndb.org/c105088]Naruto Uzumaki[/url], Sarada comes to believe that she is defined by the connections she has with others, and as a member of Team Konohamaru, she seeks to someday become Hokage so that she can connect with as many people as possible.
